proposals.note: Cyclically symmetric ring ansatz: RY(θ1) on all sites, RZZ(θ2) on all 6 ring edges, RX(θ3) on all sites, RZZ(θ4) on all 6 ring edges. 24 gates, 4 tied params. RZZ directly generates Z_iZ_j correlations matching the 15 pairwise readout observables; alternating RY/RX basis rotations between entangling layers enrich the correlation structure. Full C6 cyclic invariance reduces effective parameter space and regularises training, targeting the low dev-risk regime seen in c0002/c0004 while adding a second entangling layer for greater expressivity.

proposals.note: Inspired by c0005 (lowest dev risk 0.0024) but replaces its uniform 12-RZZ skip-1 ring with a two-scale entanglement: 6 ring RZZ (nearest-neighbor, param t0) plus 6 RZZ combining diametrically-opposed pairs (0-3,1-4,2-5) and a skip-2 triangle (0-2,2-4,4-0) sharing param t1. This gives the same 24-gate / 4-param budget but concentrates long-range correlations into fewer tied parameters, reducing the effective search space while preserving full connectivity. The cyclic-shift hypothesis [1,2,3,4,5,0] is exactly respected by the ring, the cross pairs, and the triangle (0→2→4→0 maps to 1→3→5→1), so the block is equivariant under the 6-fold rotation group.

proposals.note: Replaces the second RZZ layer of c0005 with a CRZ layer on the same ring-adjacent pairs. RZZ is symmetric (Z⊗Z) while CRZ is directional (I⊗Z on target, Z on control), so the pair RZZ+CRZ on each edge generates the full two-qubit diagonal algebra {II,IZ,ZI,ZZ} with only two parameters. This strictly increases the reachable two-qubit correlation space compared to two RZZ layers on different pairings, while keeping gate count at 24 and parameter count at 4. Cyclic C6 symmetry is preserved: the generator [1,2,3,4,5,0] maps every gate to another gate in the block with the same tied parameter. The directional CRZ coupling should help the readout (which includes both Z_i and Z_iZ_j) capture asymmetric site-to-site dependencies in the regression targets.

proposals.note: Hybrid of top performers c0005 (12 RZZ) and c0007 (6 CRZ+6 RZZ). Use 6 CRZ on cyclic pairs to add conditional-phase entanglement (complements RZZ's diagonal ZZ coupling) while retaining 6 RZZ for direct two-body phase interaction. 6 RX and 6 RY provide single-qubit basis changes. Cyclic generator [1,2,3,4,5,0] encodes translational symmetry across the 6 indexed sites, matching the all-pairwise Z_iZ_j readout. 4 tied params keep expressivity manageable under 4 block applications (2 layers x 2 repeats) with data re-uploading.

proposals.note: Builds on c0005 (lowest dev risk 0.0024). Retains the RX/RY/RZZ 24-gate structure with 4 tied params. Entanglement uses a ring (nearest-neighbor) plus next-nearest-neighbor chord pattern giving 12 RZZ gates with full C6 cyclic symmetry. Two distinct RZZ params (rzz1 for ring, rzz2 for chords) let the model learn different coupling strengths at two length scales while preserving the cyclic relabeling invariance. The single-qubit RX and RY layers provide local rotation flexibility; the feature map re-uploading between layers supplies the data-dependent angles.

proposals.note: Interleaved brick-wall variant of the RZZ-heavy family (c0005/c0009). Each qubit receives RX then RY before its two RZZ entanglements (ring θ3, next-nearest θ4), so single-qubit basis mixing occurs locally before entangling rather than in a global sweep. This interleaving means the Z-basis correlations fed into the diagonal readout are built from already-rotated states, increasing effective expressivity per layer without adding gates. Same 6-RX/6-RY/12-RZZ count and 4 tied params as best prior; cyclic Z6 hypothesis preserved. The per-site interleaving breaks the product structure of grouped gates, giving the optimizer a richer gradient landscape while keeping the same symmetry-reduced parameter count.

proposals.note: Sweep-ring ansatz: 6 RX + 6 RY (uniform tied params a,b) then 12 RZZ in two ring topologies (nearest-neighbor param c, next-nearest param d). 24 gates, 4 params. Cyclic-shift invariant. Builds on best performer c0005 (dev 0.0024) by ordering RZZ as a sequential sweep (0→1→2→…→5→0 then 0→2→4→0→2→4) to improve gradient signal propagation through the entanglement layers while preserving the ring symmetry that aids generalization on the 21 diagonal observables.

proposals.note: Ring-topology hardware-efficient block: RX(theta) on all sites, then nearest-neighbor ring RZZ(psi) on edges (i,i+1 mod 6), then RY(phi) on all sites, then next-nearest-neighbor ring RZZ(omega) on edges (i,i+2 mod 6). The two RZZ layers together realize the complete graph K6 in the Z-basis, giving the diagonal readout (Z_i, Z_iZ_j) access to all pairwise correlations. Interleaving single-qubit rotations between entangling layers (RX-RZZ-RY-RZZ) follows the standard hardware-efficient pattern and avoids the barren-plateau risk of stacking all rotations before entanglement. Full cyclic symmetry (Z_6) is preserved: every gate at site i maps to the identical gate at site i+1 mod 6, so the block commutes with the cyclic shift and the 21 diagonal observables transform among themselves under relabeling. Four tied parameters keep the gradient landscape smooth while the two distinct RZZ topologies (distance-1 vs distance-2 ring) provide richer correlation structure than a single uniform ring, which is the key structural improvement over the flat 12-RZZ block of c0005.
